sources.shortCitation: His Master's Voice (Electrola), “Tränen weint jede Frau so gern”
sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refraingesang: Austin Egen. “Tränen weint jede Frau so gern.” Tango; His Master's Voice (Electrola), 1929. The description gives the year as 1929, names Nico Dostal as arranger, and credits the tango to Dr. Bronislaw Kaper with words by Fritz Rotter. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Tränen weint jede Frau so gern — His Master's Voice (Electrola)
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refraingesang: Austin Egen

sources.shortCitation: E.G. 2271, “Du lieber Geiger, spiel’ einen Tango für mich” (Marek Weber, 1931)
sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber, dance orchestra with refrain vocal. “Du lieber Geiger, spiel’ einen Tango für mich.” Composers given as Dr. Kaper und German, words by Fritz Rotter; recorded 24 March 1931; 78 rpm; catalogue number E.G. 2271, with 60-1520 and OD267 cited as transfer references; the reverse side is “Frühling muss es sein”. The description does not name the record label, although the E.G. series is Electrola's. Transfer published on the YouTube channel 78rpm Musik channel on 27 April 2025; the label is not shown. Accessed 17 August 2026.
sources.title: Du lieber Geiger, spiel’ einen Tango für mich — E.G. 2271, Marek Weber
sources.creator: Marek Weber, dance orchestra with refrain vocal

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll. “Signorina aus Brioni.” Tango; label credit “Tango (Fritz Rotter und Dr. Kaper); Text: Fritz Rotter und Dr. Kaper”. Electrola, Katalog-Nr. E.G. 2400, n.d. The label also carries the B.I.E.M. mark and the designation Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang; the uploader identifies the refrain singer billed as Leo Moll as Leo Monosson, gives 1931 as the year of release, and illustrates the transfer with a photograph of Brioni from 1930. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Signorina aus Brioni — Electrola E.G. 2400
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Refrain: Leo Moll

sources.shortCitation: Electrola EG 2508, “Du bist in meinem Leben die erste Sensation”
sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Gesang: John Hendrik. “Du bist in meinem Leben die erste Sensation.” Tango; Electrola, Katalog-Nr. EG 2508, 1932. The upload opens with a caption card giving the matrix number E-OD 795 / I and a recording date of 17 February 1932; the disc label itself is not shown, and the card carries no authorship credits. The discographic detail is the uploader's, not read from the disc.
sources.title: Du bist in meinem Leben die erste Sensation — Electrola EG 2508
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Gesang: John Hendrik

sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang. “Margarete, wander mit mir ….” Fox-Trot; label credit “Fox-Trot (Fritz Rotter und Dr. B. Kaper); Text: Fritz Rotter und Dr. B. Kaper”. Electrola, Katalog-Nr. E.G. 2406, n.d. The label carries the matrix number (60-1740), the B.I.E.M. mark and the speed 78 UMDR.; the uploader dates the Electrola recording to 1931 and links an Italian version by the Orchestra da Ballo del R. Culotta. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Margarete, wander mit mir … — Electrola E.G. 2406
sources.creator: Marek Weber und sein Orchester, Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang
sources.date: n.d. [an Electrola recording of 1931 according to the uploader]

sources.fullCitation: Jack Hylton und sein Orchester, Refrain: Siegfried Arno. “Das verliebte Orchester.” Fox-Trot; label credit “Text und Musik von Fritz Rotter und Dr. B. Kaper”. Electrola, Katalog-Nr. E.G. 2259, n.d. The label carries the matrix number (60-1496), the B.I.E.M. mark, the speed 78 UMDR. and the designation Tanz-Orchester mit Refraingesang; the uploader dates the issue to 1931 and links the Paul von Beky version of the same song. Shellac disc from the Schallarchiv of the Radiomuseum Hardthausen, its label filmed in the YouTube upload.
sources.title: Das verliebte Orchester — Electrola E.G. 2259
sources.creator: Jack Hylton und sein Orchester, Refrain: Siegfried Arno
sources.date: n.d. [issued on Electrola in 1931 according to the uploader]

sources.shortCitation: His Master's Voice E.G. 2481, “’S wird schon wieder besser” (Dolly Haas, 1932)
sources.fullCitation: Dolly Haas with a chamber orchestra directed by Hans Sommer. “'S wird schon wieder besser”, from the Ufa sound film Liebe mit Bewährungsfrist; music by Jurmann and Kaper. His Master's Voice E.G. 2481, matrix 60-1853, Berlin, 1932. The upload gives these details in its description. Published on YouTube by Marconiphone. Accessed 20 August 2026.
sources.title: ’S wird schon wieder besser — His Master's Voice E.G. 2481
sources.creator: Dolly Haas; Kammerorchester, Hans Sommer, director
